methodology.Volume: USDC committed in trades and liquidations on PredictEX prediction markets. Market prices are quoted as 1 + P(home), so each contract is valued at (price - 1) on the home/long side and (2 - price) on the away/short side, using the side of the position being opened, extended or closed.
methodology.NotionalVolume: Number of contracts traded (each contract pays out at most 1 USDC), i.e. the maximum payout traded.

Volume.Trades: USDC committed by trades that open, extend or close positions (Trade events), valued at the side of the position being acted on.
Volume.Liquidations: USDC committed by positions closed through liquidation (Liquidate events), valued at the liquidation price on the side of the liquidated position.

NotionalVolume.Trades: Contracts traded through Trade events (max payout 1 USDC each).
NotionalVolume.Liquidations: Contracts closed through Liquidate events (max payout 1 USDC each).

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees paid by traders. Locker distributions are not user fees.
methodology.Fees: Swap fees on the listed DLMM and DAMM factories plus WETH credited to U1 lockers. Excludes aggregator, keeper, flash-loan and liquidity-composition fees. DLMM uses SwapDetailed; DAMM uses changes in protocol and LP fee accumulators plus claims, in each historical fee token.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's share of swap fees accruing to the fee recipient, plus WETH credited to U1 lockers (including external funding).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Gross protocol swap-fee share accruing to the fee treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Actual WETH distributions credited to U1 lockers by RewardsAdded, including external funding. Counted in Fees and Revenue at funding time, not again when users claim. No fixed forwarding percentage is assumed.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The share of swap fees that accrues to liquidity providers.
methodology.Volume: Sum of the input amount of every swap on Umbrae's DLMM (Liquidity Book style concentrated liquidity) and DAMM (dynamic-fee constant product) pools on Base. Pools are enumerated on chain from their factories and volume is read from each pool's swap events.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Total swap fees charged by Umbrae DLMM and DAMM pools.
Fees.U1 Locker Distributions: WETH credited to U1 lockers, including external funding.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Total swap fees charged by Umbrae DLMM and DAMM pools, all of which is paid by traders.

Revenue.U1 Locker Distributions: WETH credited to U1 lockers, including external funding.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Gross swap-fee accrual to the fee treasury.

HoldersRevenue.U1 Locker Distributions: WETH credited to U1 lockers at funding time, not again when users claim it.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To LPs: Liquidity provider share of swap fees.

methodology.Volume: Volume of real-estate NFTs purchased on LienFi.

methodology.Fees: The tax BaseStonk's Uniswap v4 hook takes on every swap in a launched token's pool, from the hook's FeeTaken event. Each launch sets its own buy and sell rate. A buy pays the tax in the launch token and a sell in the pair; token-denominated amounts are converted into the pair at the pool price the same transaction's Swap reports.
methodology.Revenue: The platform's cut of the tax plus what reaches BSTONK holders: half the tax capped at 1% of the trade to the treasury, any part of the creator's cut the payee list left unplaced and the hook swept to the treasury, and the share of the creator's cut paid to BSTONK's dividend distributor, to the BSTONK basket vault, or burnt as BSTONK.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The treasury's take: half the tax capped at 1% of the trade, plus unplaced creator fees swept to it.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Value to BSTONK holders, paid by the hook in the transaction the fee was taken: BSTONK's own pool pays its creator cut to BSTONK's dividend distributor and burns half of it, and launches carry the BSTONK basket vault as a payee; the vault pays BSTONK holders in rounds. Base only - BSTONK lives on Base.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator's cut of the tax less what the treasury swept and what reached BSTONK holders: the creator's wallets, the launch token's own holders through its dividend distributor, the burn of the launch token and the hook-owned liquidity wedge, as each launch configured them.
methodology.Volume: The pair side of every swap in a taxed pool, including the creator's dev buy at launch and excluding the hook's own buyback and liquidity swaps. Counted under Uniswap v4 as well.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: The hook's tax on each swap in a launched token's pool, at the launch's buy or sell rate.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: The platform's cut of the tax: half of it, capped at 1% of the trade, paid to the treasury.
Revenue.Unplaced Creator Fees To Treasury: The part of the creator's cut the launch's payee list left unplaced, swept to the treasury.
Revenue.Swap Fees To BSTONK Holders: The creator cut of BSTONK's own pool, paid to BSTONK's dividend distributor.
Revenue.Basket Dividends To BSTONK Holders: Paid by the hook to the BSTONK basket vault as a payee on launches.
Revenue.BSTONK Burn: BSTONK the hook burnt from BSTONK's own pool: the launch token on buys, bought back on sells.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: The platform's cut of the tax: half of it, capped at 1% of the trade, paid to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Unplaced Creator Fees To Treasury: The part of the creator's cut the launch's payee list left unplaced, swept to the treasury.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To BSTONK Holders: The creator cut of BSTONK's own pool, paid to BSTONK's dividend distributor.
HoldersRevenue.Basket Dividends To BSTONK Holders: Paid by the hook to the BSTONK basket vault as a payee on launches.
HoldersRevenue.BSTONK Burn: BSTONK the hook burnt from BSTONK's own pool: the launch token on buys, bought back on sells.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Creators And Token Holders: The creator's cut after the treasury's sweep and BSTONK holders' share: creator wallets, the token's own holders, its burn and its liquidity wedge.

methodology.Volume: USDC wagered: both stakes of every market at the moment they lock into escrow (a market is only created on-chain once fully matched). This is betting volume, not deposits — funding a balance is not counted, only money committed to a bet. Each dollar is counted exactly once: the two stakes come from two different bettors, so this is the pot, not the maker/taker double count an orderbook has to halve. Cancelled markets refund the stakes, but the matched notional stays counted, in line with other prediction markets.
methodology.Fees: Protocol fee plus judge fee, both charged on the pot when the winner claims.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol fee share of claims, paid to the protocol fee collector.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol fee share of claims, paid to the protocol fee collector.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Judge fees paid to the human judges who resolve bets.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Zero. There is no token.

Fees.Protocol fee on bet claim: Protocol fee taken from the pot when the winner claims (protocolFee on the Claimed event). The on-chain rate is 0 bps at launch, so this reads 0 until it is raised.
Fees.Judge fee on bet claim: Judge fee taken from the pot when the winner claims (arbiterFee on the Claimed event). Set per bet by the creator; 0 when the bet uses the house judge or names no fee.

Revenue.Protocol fee on bet claim: The protocol fee share, paid to the protocol fee collector.

SupplySideRevenue.Judge fee on bet claim: Judge fees paid to the human judges who resolve bets.

methodology.Volume: USD value of the stablecoin leg of every buy and sell made by a copyfomo user wallet on the same chain. Deposits, withdrawals and transfers between a user's own wallets are excluded, since they have no matching token leg. Cross-chain trades filled by an intent solver (about 7% of trades) are not counted, so this is a lower bound on copyfomo's own reported volume.
Swap volume on the pools of tokens launched on Peddles, counted once per trade on the side the token is paired against: ETH or a tokenised stock.

methodology.Revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.Volume: Input amount of every filled PancakeSwap X order. MultiReactor router fills emit FillData with the resolved input token and amount; fills on standalone reactors emit only Fill, so the input is read from the swapper-to-filler token transfer in the same transaction.

Swap volume of the pools the Homelander plugin runs in, measured on the pool's first token and excluding the plugin's own arbitrage legs. Pools are read from each chain's plugin factory, except on Flare, Soneium and Somnia, where they are named in the adapter because those public nodes cannot serve the factory history.

methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees - traders pay all of it; liquidity providers are not charged.
methodology.Fees: Everything traders pay on a swap: the pool's swap fee from the Swap event (protocol fee included), plus what a Latch launch pool's guard takes itself - the creator tax, and on newer launch guards the guard's part of the trade fee - read from the guard's TaxTaken and FeeTaken events. Only Latch's own launch guards are read.
methodology.Revenue: What reaches the protocol, counted when the fee is taken: the protocol fee each Swap event carries; the protocol's share of a launch pool's liquidity fees under the pool's permanent LP lock split, only where the locks provably hold all of the pool's liquidity; and the protocol's share of the creator tax and guard trade fee under the split the guard stores for that pool. A split that cannot be read is never guessed: that amount is left out of Revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All of Revenue. Latch has no token, so nothing is diverted to holders.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees minus Revenue: swap fees earned by liquidity providers, and the shares of locked-liquidity fees, creator tax and guard trade fees that go to launch creators and integrators (and any guard-taken amount whose split could not be read).
methodology.Volume: Gross input of every swap on CLPoolManager and BinPoolManager, one leg per swap. Swaps in Latch's own test tokens (LTT1/LTT2 on Robinhood Chain) are excluded: they have no market and no price.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fee charged by the pool, read from each Swap event.
Fees.Launch Trade Fees: The part of a launch pool's trade fee that the launch guard takes itself (FeeTaken).
Fees.Creator Tax: Buy/sell tax a launch pool's guard takes after the swap (TaxTaken).

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fee charged by the pool, read from each Swap event.
UserFees.Launch Trade Fees: The part of a launch pool's trade fee that the launch guard takes itself (FeeTaken).
UserFees.Creator Tax: Buy/sell tax a launch pool's guard takes after the swap (TaxTaken).

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Protocol fee slice of the swap fee, at the rate each Swap event carried on chain.
Revenue.Locked Liquidity Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of a launch pool's liquidity fees under its LP lock split.
Revenue.Launch Trade Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of the guard-taken trade fee under the pool's fee split.
Revenue.Creator Tax To Protocol: Protocol share of the creator tax under the pool's tax split.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Protocol fee slice of the swap fee, at the rate each Swap event carried on chain.
ProtocolRevenue.Locked Liquidity Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of a launch pool's liquidity fees under its LP lock split.
ProtocolRevenue.Launch Trade Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of the guard-taken trade fee under the pool's fee split.
ProtocolRevenue.Creator Tax To Protocol: Protocol share of the creator tax under the pool's tax split.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Liquidity Providers: Swap fee remaining after the protocol slice, earned by liquidity providers.
SupplySideRevenue.Locked Liquidity Fees To Creators And In: Creator and integrator shares of a launch pool's liquidity fees under its LP lock split.
SupplySideRevenue.Launch Trade Fees To Creators And Integr: Creator and integrator shares of the guard-taken trade fee.
SupplySideRevenue.Launch Trade Fees, Split Not Read: Guard-taken trade fee whose split could not be read; none of it is counted as Revenue.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Tax To Creators And Integrators: Creator and integrator shares of the creator tax.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Tax, Split Not Read: Creator tax whose split could not be read; none of it is counted as Revenue.

methodology.Volume: Native coin paid on buys and received on sells on ADEXTO bonding curves, gross of fees. Trades by the ADEXTO team's own wallets are excluded.
methodology.Fees: All swap fees paid by traders on ADEXTO bonding curves, read from each Swap event: the creator, curve reserve, buyback and protocol legs. Rates are set per market at launch and never change; the launch presets are 1.00% on factory 1.0.0 and 0.12.0 markets and 0.40% on factory 0.11.0 markets.
methodology.UserFees: All swap fees paid by traders.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol leg of every swap, paid to the ADEXTO protocol treasury: 0.10% of the trade on factory 0.11.0, 0.12.0 and 1.0.0 markets, where it is a factory constant. Factory 0.10.0 markets have no protocol leg.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol leg of every swap, paid to the ADEXTO protocol treasury: 0.10% of the trade on factory 0.11.0, 0.12.0 and 1.0.0 markets, where it is a factory constant. Factory 0.10.0 markets have no protocol leg.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator leg paid to each market's creator, the reserve leg that stays in the market's curve, and the buyback leg that buys and burns the market's own token.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid on ADEXTO bonding curves, read from the fee legs every Swap event carries.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on ADEXTO bonding curves.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol leg, accrued on each curve and claimable only to the immutable ADEXTO protocol treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol leg, accrued on each curve and claimable only to the immutable ADEXTO protocol treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Creators: The creator leg, claimable only to the market's immutable creator. Launch presets: 0.70% of each trade on factory 1.0.0 and 0.12.0 markets, 0.10% on factory 0.11.0 markets; actual amounts are read from each Swap event.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Curve Reserves: The depth leg, which stays in the market's curve reserve and raises its price floor.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Token Buyback And Burn: The buyback leg, spent only on buying and burning the market's own token.
